label: Software
summary: A codebase with a gate (tests, build, lint) that must pass before any push. Phases ship slices; nothing is published, deployed or paid without the owner.

first_phase.title: Walking skeleton: the gate runs, one end-to-end path works

questions.ask: The stack in one line: language, framework, database, runtime version.
The commands that must pass before a push, one per line (for example: npm test, npm run build). Write 'none yet' if the project has none.
How it reaches users: 'not deployed', 'manual', or 'automatic on push to <branch>' with the platform.
